# portals

XDG desktop portals: wlr for screenshots and screen sharing, GTK for file pickers and settings, gnome-keyring for secrets.

Screen sharing asks for an output with `slurp-pick` (click a monitor).

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`portals/packages`): `xdg-desktop-portal`, `xdg-desktop-portal-gtk`, `xdg-desktop-portal-wlr`, `gnome-keyring`

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.config/xdg-desktop-portal-wlr/config`
- `~/.config/xdg-desktop-portal/mango-portals.conf`
